title: JavaScript Fundamentals
description: Master the core concepts of JavaScript including variables, functions, closures, promises, and ES6+ features. Build real-world projects from day one.

title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: A rigorous introduction to classic data structures (arrays, trees, graphs, hash maps) and algorithmic thinking with complexity analysis.

title: React & Modern Frontend
description: Build dynamic, component-driven UIs using React 18. Covers hooks, state management, context API, routing, and performance optimization.

title: Python for Data Science
description: Comprehensive Python course covering NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Scikit-learn for data analysis, visualization, and machine learning.

title: Database Design & SQL
description: Learn relational database concepts, ER modelling, normalization (1NF–3NF), and write complex SQL queries including joins, subqueries, and window functions.

title: Cloud Computing with AWS
description: Explore core AWS services including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and CloudFront. Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud architectures.

title: UI/UX Design Principles
description: Deep dive into user-centred design thinking, wireframing, prototyping, accessibility standards, and usability testing methodologies.

title: DevOps & CI/CD Pipelines
description: Understand DevOps culture, containerisation with Docker, orchestration with Kubernetes, and building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins.

title: Cybersecurity Essentials
description: Understand threat landscapes, encryption, network security, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, penetration testing fundamentals, and security best practices.

title: Machine Learning A–Z
description: From linear regression to deep neural networks — this course covers supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning with TensorFlow and PyTorch.
